answer: Put light client proof of Aptos state at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 479 fakes spends 8622 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the vault of the check, count the relic of the cost, and read the timber of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
